spec: §15 suite G (ownership rules); §10: bennett_unload with a run not CLOSED is E_INVALID_STATE; tokens are destroyed at unload
derivation: After a COMPLETED run that was never closed, bennett_unload must fail with E_INVALID_STATE and free nothing; closing the run first makes the same unload succeed.
